title: Missing panel?
text:
Missing panel?. I was so excited about this. I open it and it looked great til I turned it around and there metal panels on 3 sides, not all 4. So now to display it, I cannot put it "wherever" I have yo put it where that back side faces a wall.
Had that panel been there thus would have gotten 5 stars. So disappointed.

product_metadata.title: Autumn Alley Barn Door Square Farmhouse Tissue Box Cover in White and Galvanized – Farmhouse Bathroom Accessories – Rustic Bathroom Décor Tissue Holder | Wood Shabby Chic Tissue Box Cover
features: 【Wooden Farmhouse Tissue Box Holder】Add a dash of warm-earthy class to your country bathroom, living space or shabby chic kitchen AND keep facial tissues handy with a rustic wood bathroom accessory. Absolutely Charming. Practical. Gloriously sturdy.
【Unique Mix of Barnwood and Metal】Solid, lasting construction out of white-washed natural fir wood and corrugated aged galvanized metal. Impeccably made with outstanding attention to details.

【Easy Refills with Slide Out Bottom】Our 6 3/8" cube tissue box cover completely encloses your cardboard tissue box. Feel free to pick it up and move it anywhere it's needed without worrying about your tissue box dropping out. It is sized to fit all tissue box cubes and has no sharp edges to scratch your vanity, nightstand or tabletops. It makes a warm, inviting statement in your modern farmhouse home.

【Shabby Chic Charm】The popular barn door design in our kleenex holder for bathroom adds just the right rustic touch to your country home. The solid wood and metal dispenser makes this a quality piece that will grace your farmhouse kitchen, living room or bathroom for years. The larger cube tissue box, makes it very stable so you can dispense tissues from this wooden tissue box holder without any concern of it lifting up or toppling over.

【There's More!】This piece joins our popular line of barn door inspired farmhouse bathroom accessories. Add our towel rack, ring hand towel holder, and toilet paper holder to coordinate your entire rustic bathroom. Check out our barn door kitchen collection too!
